160090101.text: Okay, we'll deliver these letters to the Adventurers' Guild and The Cat's Tail! You can just handle the ones for the Angel's Share.

160090102.text: Phew... The expedition is finally wrapping up. I hope the maps I made on our way there are good enough to get them safely home.

160090201.text: Ah, welcome back, old friend. And how should I be addressing you these days? The Honorary Knight of Mondstadt? The "Tumaini" of Natlan? Or the great hero of Nod-Krai?

160090202.text: Just call me by my name...

160090203.text: Wow, you sure have your finger on the pulse... We've barely caught our breath since Nod-Krai, but it sounds like you've already heard about what went down.

160090204.text: Heh, news travels fast on the wind. But before I can turn your tales into tunes, I need to hear them from the horse's mouth.

160090205.text: #My wine and my lyre are at the ready. So please, {NICKNAME}, take a seat and tell me your tale.

160090206.text: You tell Venti everything that happened in Nod-Krai...

160090207.text: ...Amazing, incredible! The Rächer of Solnari and The Doctor... Truly a tale for the ages!

160090208.text: So I'm guessing the Wild Hunt is a thing of the past now that you've defeated the Rächer of Solnari?

160090209.text: Seems that way... We were kinda focused on dealing with The Doctor, though.

160090212.text: Well, that's good to hear. Hey, now that the Northern Abyss Calamity is finally resolved, Varka must be getting ready for the triumphant return of his expedition, right?

160090213.text: I haven't seen him in the longest time... He must have so many stories to share.

160090214.text: I was gonna ask... You two have really met before?

160090215.text: Right, Paimon was wondering about that too! He did call you Barbatos... But weren't you still fast asleep back when he was in Mondstadt?

160090216.text: Umm... Let's call it half-asleep. I was resting my eyes in the Thousand Winds Temple one day when I heard a commotion outside...

160090217.text: It was a young knight, who had journeyed there in search of trials and oracles after hearing some tall tales at the local tavern...

160090218.text: In fact, all that awaited him were moss-covered walls and an angry Ruin Guard. But he seemed completely unfazed, laughing heartily as he sent the Ruin Guard's missiles flying off into the horizons...

160090219.text: They must have been making quite a racket if it was enough to wake up the Tone-Deaf Bard...

160090222.text: Hey! Is that all you've got?

160090225.text: Giving up already? Hey, you're not half as tough as Varka said.

160090226.text: A young Knight of Favonius, trekking out to the Thousand Winds Temple in search of adventure... Now there's a sight I haven't seen in a while.

160090227.text: Hmm? A bard in green clothes... Does this mean... you're Venti?

160090228.text: Hah! I was just wondering how I was gonna track you down.

160090229.text: Oh... So you were looking for the Tone-Deaf Bard? Strange place to start your search...

160090301.text: ...Surely, there's no way anyone found the secret stash of cash in my office? That would be terrible...

160090302.text: Grand Master! Bad time to get distracted!

160090304.text: Huh? Oh, it's just a few stragglers. They're no real threat to us.

160090305.text: This expedition is almost over. We just need to deal with these final few targets... and then...

160090306.text: We will make our triumphant return!

160090401.text: He wants to test me to see if my skills have regressed? Hmph, I still haven't forgotten how he went easy on me last time!

160090402.text: I'm assuming you must have seen him going all out before? When the time comes, you'd better keep an eye on him for me!

160090501.text: Without the Rächer of Solnari to direct them, it seems like all that's left is their primal urge to destroy.

160090502.text: If this is all that the Wild Hunt can muster now, surely the Lightkeepers of Nod-Krai will be able to deal with what's left?

160090503.text: (Just like I thought... What we should be wary of now, is—)

160090504.text: Grand Master, based on Lightkeeper intel and our own reconnaissance, one of the suspected targets should be just up ahead.

160090505.text: Good. You know the drill — Stay here and stand guard. Leave the rest to me.

160090601.text: (Everything seems normal so far... Here's hoping I'm just overthinking things. There are two other places to check... Maybe this'll all go smoothly after all?)

160090604.text: ...Although if we're returning to your old home, perhaps "Andrius" is a little too ostentatious...

160090605.text: Hmm, might be better to go by...

160090610.text: Is the surface world still as wretched and foul as ever?

160090611.text: Answer me, heir to the knighthood of Boreas.

160090612.text: Heh... Looks like I'm not getting out of this without a fight!

subQuests.subQuestName: Read the Grand Master's letter together

160090701.text: "...That's where things stand with the expedition. The victors will be returning home soon — so make sure to stock up on wine for the celebrations!"

160090702.text: "P.S.: I hope everyone's keeping up with their daily training! I'll be testing you all when I get back to make sure no one's regressed."

160090703.text: "P.P.S.: I wrote individual letters for each and every one of you. Don't forget to write back!" — That's all.

160090705.text: Everyone gets one? Wow, Sir Writes-A-Lot is really living up to his name!

160090706.text: I guess the Grand Master must have something specific to say to each of us.

160090707.text: Even I got a letter — and I'm not a real Knight yet...

160090710.text: Oh... Yes, that's our Grand Master for you.

160090711.text: By the way, anyone know where I can find the Cavalry Captain? I have a letter for him as well.

160090712.text: You mean, Kaeya? He said he was meeting a friend from the church at the Angel's Share.

160090713.text: Allegedly for work — said he was "exchanging intel." But I'd say there's a fifty-fifty chance he's just there for a drink.

160090716.text: Paimon bets there'll be lots of familiar faces there... How about we deliver Kaeya's letter? ...And these other two as well!

160090717.text: Really? That would be a great help, thank you.

160090718.text: Our thanks to you too, Lohen. The other knights will help distribute the remaining letters. You've had a long journey — please, go get some rest.

160090719.text: Great! But I won't be resting just yet. I have one last letter to deliver to Wolvendom. This one, I was planning on delivering personally.

160090720.text: I heard that another challenger recently passed Boreas's trial? Well, with any luck, that wolf might be willing to reveal himself to me, too...

160090721.text: *sigh* ...Very well. But please remember to show respect to the local wolves.

160090724.text: (Clearly, something is bothering Jean. I should talk to her before going to the Angel's Share.)

160093305.text: Huh? But... Varka's coming back, the situation in Nod-Krai is stable... Surely things are looking up?

160093306.text: True. From what you and Lohen have told me, the expedition has indeed accomplished its strategic objectives.

160093307.text: It seems that Mondstadt no longer faces any threat from the perils of the North, be they the Wild Hunt or The Doctor.

160093308.text: And yet... For some reason, I can't help but recall something the Grand Master said to me before he left...

160093309.text: ...If I don't make it back from this expedition, you'll have to assume the mantle of Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.

160093310.text: If it comes to that, remember to train the next Knight of Boreas in my stead.

160093311.text: I've planted some promising seeds in Mondstadt, but they still need time to grow.

160093312.text: Some have yet to master the art of social interaction, some don't yet understand that they, too, need protecting, and some... Well, some might not even want to be a knight yet.

160093313.text: ...What's wrong? Ah, there's no need to frown — I'm going on an expedition, not marching to my death! This is all just a contingency plan in the event that I'm unable to return.

160093314.text: Until I return, I leave them in your care.

160093315.text: ...The lineage of the Knights of Boreas has nearly been extinguished twice in Mondstadt's history.

160093316.text: The first wandering knight to claim the title arrived in Mondstadt a thousand years ago, along with his wolf companion.

160093317.text: He was as free as the wind. He left no succession plan behind — even his name was lost to history. The title of "Boreas" could have disappeared from Mondstadt just as he did...

160093318.text: But he had an informal disciple — a knight named Ravenwood, who admired the Knight of Boreas greatly. Ravenwood's valor and swordsmanship earned him the Wolf Spirit's recognition...

160093319.text: ...When the old aristocracy tried to regain power, Ravenwood came once more to Mondstadt's defense. From then on, the title of Knight of Boreas was passed down from generation to generation within the Knights of Favonius.

160093320.text: "Wolf Spirit"... You mean that big blue wolf in Wolvendom?

160093321.text: Correct. As you may already know, the Wo{RUBY#[D]Boreas}lf of the North is the surviving spirit of an ancie{RUBY#[D]Andrius}nt god.

160093322.text: And the Knight of Boreas serves as an intermediary between him and humanity.

160093323.text: "Lupus Boreas, who had never known what it meant to love, came to understand it through the journey with his human companion. In the end, he chose to allow his power to become one with the land..."

160093324.text: This was once a well-known tale in Mondstadt. But these days, few people are aware that the starting point of the Wolf King's journey was not Mondstadt, but Nod-Krai.

subQuests.subQuestName: Leave the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

160090801.text: "When you're mixing drinks in hot weather, start by pouring in cold water, and add ice cubes, then drain out the water before adding the other ingredients." How's that for a secret recipe? Maybe it's worth a little intel in return?

160090802.text: *scoff* Please, I've known that little trick for a good ten years at least. You'll have to offer something a little more substantial if you're serious about trading.

160090803.text: I know there's no one else in the tavern right now, but do you two really need to talk so loudly? Especially if you're supposed to be exchanging confidential information.

160090804.text: Kaeya! Rosaria! Diluc! Paimon knew we'd find you here!

160090805.text: ...Looks like it's about to get even noisier.

160090806.text: #Haha, a little liveliness never killed anyone. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, what brings you our way?

160090807.text: I have a letter for each of you...

160090808.text: You deliver Varka's letters to their recipients...

160090809.text: "...Please allow me to once again express my sincere condolences regarding your late father and the incident with Eroch. We make absolutely no excuse for his crimes."

160090810.text: "...I hope you will give some serious consideration to the question I asked you before I left — though I'm sure you're tired of hearing me ask by now. The Knights of Favonius will always welcome you."

160090812.text: From the look on your face, I'm guessing the Grand Master is still refusing to drop it?

160090813.text: He nags like an old man. It's hardly surprising.

160090814.text: Huh? Drop what? What's this about?

160090815.text: Nothing, really. Before leaving on the expedition, Varka came here to chat with me over a drink. I failed to avoid him.

160090816.text: He asked me if I'd consider rejoining the Knights of Favonius, and I declined. He expressed his regret about everything that happened and asked me to reconsider. That's all there is to it.

160090817.text: Yeah, right... Sounds like you skipped a lot of details. There's clearly more to it!

160090818.text: Whatever details I chose to omit are in the past. Dragging them back up now serves no purpose.

160090819.text: You say that now, but back then, you couldn't let it go. You and the Knights of Favonius were constantly at odds.

160090820.text: ...I wasn't seeing the full picture. I've had a lot of time to reflect since then.

160090821.text: But my answer remains unchanged — I'm not rejoining the Knights of Favonius.

160090822.text: Both the Grand Master and the Acting Grand Master are too upright and honorable.

160090823.text: They can't see the shadows that lurk beneath them due to the size of the organization they lead... They need someone on the outside to keep watch vigilantly.

160090824.text: If I had a Mora for every time I've heard you repeat that argument... I actually don't disagree with the first part of what you said. But don't you think someone can keep tabs on things from the inside?

160090825.text: When you join an organization, you're bound by its rules, no matter how free it may seem on the surface.

160090826.text: You think so? Never mind the Knights... Have you honestly ever been bound by the rules of the Church?

160090827.text: Good question. Have you considered that maybe, that's why I chose to join the church and not the Knights to begin with?

160090828.text: #Um... {NICKNAME}, are they arguing or not? It's kinda hard to tell...

160090831.text: #Ohh... Kinda like the "contingencies" Jean was talking about? The more ways they have to protect their home, the better! ...Huh? {NICKNAME}?

160090832.text: (I wonder if... this is exactly what Varka was hoping for?)

160091001.text: What should I report back to the Grand Master on? Let me think...

160091002.text: Public order inside the city, monster activity in the wild... oh, and a review of the latest vintages. Haha, I think I'll leave it at that.

160090901.text: My reply won't be a long one — as usual. I'm sure Varka won't be surprised.

160091101.text: If you hadn't had to deliver that guy's mail, you wouldn't have been subjected to all this tedious arguing. When I write back, I'll tell him to quit making trouble for other people.

160091102.text: It's no trouble! Lohen did most of the work. We just volunteered to do the last leg of the journey — mostly so we could come say hello!

160091105.text: Heh... So you see what's really going on here. All three of us fell for that old rascal's scheme far too readily.

160091106.text: Huh? Scheme? What do you mean? Was Varka lying in his letters, then?

160091107.text: No. While I'm sure Varka knows full well that Diluc would never agree to rejoin the knights, I believe the sentiments he expressed were genuine, as was his offer to welcome Diluc back.

160091108.text: There are people like Kaeya and I... and then there are those who are true champions of justice to the core. Those people are the most susceptible to being driven to extremes by great upheaval... It's happened in Mondstadt before.

160091109.text: Not only that... But it happened to a Knight of Boreas. That'll really hit home for Varka — and that's why his nagging is even more persistent than usual.

160091201.text: The Grand Master offered lots of advice in his letter regarding my recent assessments... I didn't think he'd spare a thought for that kind of thing in the middle of an expedition.

160091202.text: So, um... Honorary Knight, if you have the time... do you think you could help me out with my special training?

160091301.text: What's going on here? Was Wolvendom always like this? Paimon has a baaad feeling about this...

160091302.text: The Wild Hunt!? What are they doing here!? ...Watch out!

160091401.text: Thank you for being such a patient listener. I feel much more settled after talking with you.

160091402.text: If you have any spare time, would you mind stopping off to say hello to the other knights? I'm sure they have all missed our Honorary Knight just as much as I have.

160091604.text: Oh no, what now? It better not be more Wild Hunt monsters...

160091607.text: Phew... You scared Paimon stiff! She thought you were—

160091608.text: Stop right there. Answer me this — the two letters I gave you, who were they for?

160091609.text: Um... Two letters? Wasn't it three...?

160094202.text: Lupus Boreas not injured... why so weak? Am I... not strong enough?

160094203.text: You are not to blame... With your Iron{RUBY#[D]blade}claw, you successfully blocked their attacks. However... their assault went beyond the mere physical world.

160094204.text: They followed my trail from the distant north across the Ley Lines... They sought to corrupt the territory I protect. But I shall not let them succeed without a fight.

160094208.text: So... Are you saying that the Wild Hunt we just got attacked by came all the way from Nod-Krai to Mondstadt? How is that even possible...

160094209.text: ...As you know, I stand before you as an incomplete being. I am but one remnant of the god, Andrius's soul.

160094210.text: The source of this turmoil... I can sense it. It lies in the north — It is the part of me that remains in Nod-Krai, from whence I came.

160094211.text: Huh? Now Paimon's even more confused! How can you be in two places at once?

160091701.text: Any questions before you set off? Better ask now — you'll probably have to hit the ground running when you get to Nod-Krai.

160091703.text: The root of this turmoil lies with the remnant soul that Andrius, Dominator of Wolves and God of the North Wind, left in Nod-Krai.

160091704.text: He once left Nod-Krai and braved the blizzards to confront the God of {RUBY#[S]Decarabian}Storms and claim the right to rule. Yet even as the tower fell, he chose to abandon his claim.

160091705.text: Instead, he returned to the North and slumbered for a thousand years, before finally journeying back — under the name of Boreas — with the first Knight of Boreas to witness the new face of Mondstadt.

160091706.text: When the wolf's spirit could no longer maintain his physical form, Boreas chose to pour his power into the Ley Lines... with that, he became the North Wind of Mondstadt, as he is still known to this day.

160091708.text: Five hundred years ago, Roland seemed destined to become the mightiest Knight of Boreas ever to have lived... But he was too pure of heart.

160091709.text: He believed firmly in his own ideals of chivalry, vowing to eliminate all injustice from the world. But the world had never been perfect and pure, nor would it ever be.

160091710.text: Neither his mentor, the "Wolf Pup" Rostam, nor the Grand Master — known as the Lion of Light — could persuade him to temper his obsession.

160091711.text: But what was the "scent that reeks of blood" that Lupus Boreas sensed? And what is its connection to Khaenri'ah and the Abyss? Perhaps you will uncover the truth in Nod-Krai.

160091713.text: The soul of a wolf is as unyielding as ice, and Andrius is a master of molding and shaping it. His people once drew great strength and wisdom from the Wolf Spirit.

160091714.text: But human hearts and flesh cannot contain the soul of a god... Attempting to place the Wolf Spirit in a human vessel would slowly devour their sense of self, even if Lupus Boreas did not intend for that to happen.

160091715.text: That's why Lupus Boreas developed the technique of imbuing weapons with his soul. It is his way of blessing his human lupical with the Wolf Spirit's protection.

160091716.text: In fact, there is an ancient song that tells this tale: "A weapon once of common iron, now through friendship turned divine, twixt man and wolf a bond was made, a power born within the blade..."

160091717.text: Hehe, as much as he might claim not to accept humans, his actions sing a different tune... Oh, but keep that little observation between us, will you?

160091801.text: The Knight of Boreas awaits below. We must part ways here. Barbatos and I have other plans — we will meet you again later.

160091802.text: Alright... Hey, wait! How are we getting down!? Aaaaah!

160091901.text: Hold the line! The enemy's on the brink of collapse!

160091904.text: Honorary Knight reporting for duty, Grand Master!

160091908.text: We're just about hanging in there. Most of their grunts are taken care of now. Their leader's gonna have to make a decision soon.

160091909.text: Fight or flight... What will it be, "Mightiest Knight of Boreas"?

160091910.text: As expected, this hastily summoned Wild Hunt horde is nothing but a disorganized rabble, a mere shadow of the forces gathered by the Rächer of Solnari.

160091911.text: But they have served their purpose. I now understand your tactics, and you, in turn, understand mine. This is fair... this is the way of chivalry.

160091912.text: Farewell, heir to the knighthood of Boreas. Whether you choose to resist me or not, I shall set right the injustices of this world... in the name of the Bloodstained Knight.

160091914.text: So that Wolf of the North lookalike... that was Andrius? But why would he be leading the Wild Hunt? And why was he talking about the Bloodstained Knight?

160091915.text: Uhh... Forget that, we can save the details for later! He was the enemy boss, right? Are we just gonna let him get away!?

160091916.text: Aah, there's no point chasing after him. We've crossed blades already, and it ended in a stalemate. Right now, there's nothing we could do about him.

160091501.text: I can read Varka's letter. I will try my best to write a reply.

160091502.text: A wolf's claws make poor instruments for writing human words. But that token will suffice to convey my thoughts.

160092001.text: I sure didn't expect my experience fighting the Wild Hunt in Nod-Krai to come in handy back here in Mondstadt. Almost makes me wonder if this was the reason I was sent back...

160092002.text: Also, how come that bard knows so much? And what was he doing at the Thousand Winds Temple...? Hmm...

160092003.text: ...Well, whatever — I don't really care, as long as I get to do some fighting. I'm looking forward to trading blows with Lupus Boreas when he's fully recovered... I bet he'll wipe the floor with me!

160092901.text: Ah, the Grand Master... The archives are filled with documents awaiting his review. I'm not letting him run off again until he's finished dealing with every last one.

160092902.text: On another note... have you spoken to Jean? I hope she'll finally be able to relax a little once Varka returns.

160093201.text: The Grand Master wrote in his letter that the Boom Blossom Bombs we sent worked really well — he wants to know if we've made any more...

160093202.text: Uncle Varka's coming home? Yay! I can't wait to go outside and play with him!

160093901.text: Let me guess... you're heading to Wolvendom next? Say hi to Razor for me.

160093902.text: Oh — but I'm not helping him write his response to Varka. He needs to learn to be independent.

160099901.text: ...Huh? Where'd this letter in our bag come from? Did it just blow in on the breeze?

160099902.text: Oh, it's from the Tone-Deaf Bard. Apparently, he wants to hear all about our adventures in Nod-Krai... Heh, maybe we can get some tasty treats out of him in return! Come on, let's go to Starsnatch Cliff!

160099903.text: ...So, you've returned from Mondstadt? Don't you want to see what it looks like now?

160099904.text: ...I was planning to take a look around there myself. Perhaps you could be my guide?

160099905.text: (What's this? ...An echo from a thousand years ago?)

160099906.text: That turned into a pretty long conversation, huh? We should probably go deliver those letters to the Angel's Share now!

160099907.text: Looks like they're finally done "not-arguing"... Let's go ask them how they plan to respond!
